g.text: Posterior densities of the between-study SD (τ) for six outcomes.
Grey density (bottom): reference prior — half-Student-t(3, 0, 1). Vertical lines: 2.5th, 50th, 97.5th posterior percentiles.
Figure S7c: Heterogeneity (τ) Posteriors — Comparison 1 M1 Models
All posteriors are substantially shifted from the prior, indicating the data are informative about τ.
IFI shows the widest posterior (median τ = 1.53), consistent with structural outlier heterogeneity identified in the
leave-one-out analysis (Appendix S9). BSI: median τ = 0.88; OS: median τ = 0.57.
